title: LLSec bit diagram labels Signer-ID bit as reserved
description: Correctness review: spec/02-physical-link.md:279-292 labels bit 7 as R in the wire diagram but the immediately following normative table defines bit 7 as Signer IID (SI). The frame layout at lines 232-244 also includes SignerID. Correct the diagram label so independent implementers do not omit or treat the on-wire field as reserved. This is separate from already-claimed h3qe/jlet production and capacity work.
